name: GMX V2 Perps
description: GMX is a decentralized spot and perpetual exchange that supports low swap fees and zero price impact trades. Trading is supported by a unique multi-asset pool that earns liquidity providers fees from market making, swap fees, leverage trading (spreads, funding fees & liquidations) and asset rebalancing.

methodology.UserFees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions, swap fees, and liquidation fees paid by traders
methodology.Fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions, swap fees, liquidation fees, and borrowing fees
methodology.Revenue: 37% of all collected fees - split between protocol treasury (10%) and GMX token holders (27%)
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of all fees goes to the protocol treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 27% of all fees goes to GMX token stakers
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 63% of all fees goes to GM token liquidity providers

Fees.Margin Fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions and borrowing fees charged to maintain leveraged positions
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Fees charged when swapping tokens through GMX v2 markets
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Fees collected when positions are liquidated due to insufficient collateral

Revenue.Margin Fees: 37% of margin and borrowing fees retained by protocol
Revenue.Token Swap Fees: 37% of swap fees retained by protocol
Revenue.Liquidation Fees: 37% of liquidation fees retained by protocol

ProtocolRevenue.Margin Fees: 10% of margin and borrowing fees to protocol treasury
ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 10% of swap fees to protocol treasury
ProtocolRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 10% of liquidation fees to protocol treasury

HoldersRevenue.Margin Fees: 27% of margin and borrowing fees distributed to GMX token stakers
HoldersRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 27% of swap fees distributed to GMX token stakers
HoldersRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 27% of liquidation fees distributed to GMX token stakers

SupplySideRevenue.Margin Fees: 63% of margin and borrowing fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 63% of swap fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 63% of liquidation fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
